Kazakhstan e-Visa
* E-Visa can be issued only if there is a valid invitation from the Kazakh side.
* To apply for an e-Visa, you need an invitation number received from the inviting Kazakh side.
* The issued electronic visa must be printed out for presentation at the state border crossing and on the territory of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
* E-Visa gives the right to enter / exit the Republic of Kazakhstan only through the international airports of Astana and Almaty.
* E-Visas are not issued to foreigners with whom children travel together.
